# Doğru Kanzlei — hasandogru.de

> Law firm for Turkish law in Mannheim, Germany.
> Led by Avukat Hasan Doğru, member of the Ankara Bar Association (No. 47068) and registered with the Karlsruhe Bar (Rechtsanwaltskammer Karlsruhe) under § 207 BRAO.
> Scope: Turkish law only. No advice on German law — including German residence/immigration law (Ausländerbehörde), German employment law and German social-benefits law.

## Firm
- Name: Doğru Kanzlei
- Lawyer: Hasan Doğru (Avukat, Turkish lawyer)
- Location: R1 2,3, 68161 Mannheim, Germany
- Second office: Çankaya / Ankara, Turkey
- Languages: Turkish, German, English
- Experience: 15+ years
- Google rating: 5.0 stars (70+ reviews)

## Practice Areas (Turkish law)
- Recognition & enforcement of German judgments and divorces in Turkey (Tanıma & Tenfiz)
- Turkish inheritance law (Veraset İlamı, estates in Turkey)
- Turkish family law: divorce and maintenance before Turkish courts
- Residence in Turkey, Mavi Kart and Turkish citizenship
- Turkish criminal law (proceedings and arrest warrants in Turkey)
- Turkish real estate law (Tapu, property in Turkey)
- Debt enforcement in Turkey (İcra)
- Turkish entry bans and visa refusals
- Powers of attorney for use in Turkey (Vekaletname)
- Legal opinions on Turkish law

## Bar Registration
Registered under § 207 BRAO with the Rechtsanwaltskammer Karlsruhe, which permits advice on Turkish law and public international law in Germany.
Ankara Bar Association membership No. 47068.
